svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — R0 Money Path
proposal → underwriting → payment → reconciliation → issuance → SOLD · the twenty steps that move money and the five ways they fail · companion to docs/hdl.svg
THE INVARIANT THIS ENTIRE FLOW EXISTS TO PROTECT
INV-JRN-05 — a journey reaches SOLD only when policy issuance, payment reconciliation and audit completeness are ALL confirmed.

Issued-but-unreconciled is not a sale. Paid-but-unissued is not a sale. Complete-but-unevidenced is not a sale. Every failure branch below is a way one of the three legs goes missing — and each is caught rather than assumed away.
hard gate — C1 suitability valid & unexpired · C2 consent current
either missing or stale → 403, journey does not advance (FF-08 / FF-09)
references only — never another context's decision (SC-W3-6)
per-provider bulkhead · one insurer cannot drain the pool
reference is the recovery handle — never a blind resubmit (S-12)
async-poll (S-09 / S-11); no user connection held open
payment is unreachable until this stage is recorded
create payment session (amount = selected offer premium)
charged amount must equal the quoted premium — else reject (S-13)
dispatch payment link to the customer device
#17 SMS/email to the customer only — never to an RM or bank device (C4)
one-time link · short expiry · bound to the OTP-verified device
no RM-device payment route exists in the interface (DEC-20260816-12)
customer pays — 3-D Secure, on their own device
the bank never sees the instrument
signature + txn match + replay window — a callback is a claim, not proof (S-14)
reconcile callback against the settlement file (T+1)
reconciliation decides whether money moved — not the callback, not a DB restore (S-15)
UNCERTAIN never becomes success by timeout, retry or optimism
issuance is attempted only against a RECONCILED payment (SC-W3-4)
via the same provider seam; no direct insurer call exists
SOLD gate — issued ∧ reconciled ∧ audit complete (INV-JRN-05)
audit completeness is a precondition, not a post-hoc report

Any one leg missing leaves the journey in a named non-terminal state with an owned operations task (S-19). There is no state transition that reaches SOLD by elapsed time, by retry count, or by an operator's judgement.
FAILURE BRANCHES — EACH ONE IS A WAY A LEG OF THE INVARIANT GOES MISSING
no authenticated callback inside the session window
payment := UNCERTAIN — never SUCCESS, never FAILED
T+1 settlement file is the arbiter (S-15)
ops break task (S-19); journey blocked from SOLD
assume success · re-charge · let the RM 'confirm' it
same idempotency key seen inside the 24 h contract
unchanged — the first result is replayed verbatim
409 — a changed replay is a defect, not an update
create a second proposal or a second charge
policy exists at the insurer; payment ≠ RECONCILED
journey stays NOT SOLD — visibly, in the RM workspace
finance break queue; refund or recover to reconciled
escalates as a money-movement exception, not a bug
report the sale because the policy number exists
no ack, or poll deadline exceeded on insurerRef
journey resumable at its recorded stage (S-12)
status recovered by reference — submission is never repeated
per-provider bulkhead contains it to one insurer
blind resubmit · hold a user connection open
outbox row unconsumed past its threshold (S-17)
business action retained and retried, at-least-once
journey completion waits for required evidence
SOLD is unreachable — the third leg cannot be waived
complete a regulated journey on partial evidence
synchronous call — caller waits, deadline enforced
asynchronous — outbox event, poll, or provider callback
#n bounded context (business-problem-statement §6) · S-nn / INV-* / FF-nn as used in docs/hdl.svg · W1–W4 build waves
